dedupeText: retro mariachi ensemble album cover 1960s mariachi sombrero marimba psychedelic typography sepia tone kitsch the central group of musicians is framed within a large white rectangular inset the display typography at the top mirrors the curved organic lines of the outer border the marimba acts as a horizontal anchor for the seated and standing figures take a centered group portrait frame it with a 1960s multi line rounded border and top it with flared top heavy psychedelic lettering and a red sans serif tracklist

recipe.visualDefinition: A group of men in stylized mariachi attire posing around a large marimba instrument. The scene is framed by a thick, multi-line border with psychedelic, top-heavy display typography at the head and a list of tracks below it. The aesthetic is mid-century kitsch with a warm, desaturated color palette.
coreVisualRelationships: The central group of musicians is framed within a large white rectangular inset.
The display typography at the top mirrors the curved, organic lines of the outer border.
The marimba acts as a horizontal anchor for the seated and standing figures.
coreInvariants: Group posing with raised fists or expressive gestures

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The ensemble is centered in the lower two-thirds of the frame, scaled to fit within the white inset.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large wooden marimba in the center foreground.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the large top text, move down through the tracklist, and settle on the central seated figure before radiating out to the standing members.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample beige space around the figures within the inset to emphasize the group silhouette.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm beige and tan (background and skin tones)
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Dark brown and olive (borders and instrument)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Muted pink and orange (scarves and sashes)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high value in the central white panel.

letterConstructionRules: Flared terminals and curved, organic stems
Tapered waists on characters like 'B' and 'R'
Uniform stroke width for the secondary sans-serif text
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'A' features a high, narrow crossbar
The 'B' has a significantly larger upper bowl than lower bowl
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast pairing between fluid, decorative display type and rigid, functional sans-serif metadata.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the top-heavy, fluid nature of the main title.
Provides the necessary wide-tracking, small-cap feel for the tracklist.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A studio photograph of a 7-man mariachi band in brown suits and sombreros, posing around a large wooden marimba on a beige background. The image is placed inside a white square inset, which is itself inside a thick olive-brown multi-line border with rounded corners.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply a large, custom psychedelic display title in the top section of the border using a tan fill and brown outline. Below it, add two rows of small, wide-spaced red sans-serif text listing song titles.

verificationChecks: Is the main title top-heavy and flared?
Is the border composed of multiple concentric lines?
Are the colors muted and warm (browns, tans, olives)?
Is the tracklist text red and centered?

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text does not overlap the musicians.
Check that the border lines are consistent in thickness.
Verify the 'psychedelic' font style is applied only to the main title.
Confirm the overall color temperature is warm.
recipe.reuseFormula: Take a centered group portrait, frame it with a 1960s multi-line rounded border, and top it with flared, top-heavy psychedelic lettering and a red sans-serif tracklist.
